creative_analysis.insight: Cold audience creatives (cr_002, cr_003) share a pattern: they lead with cost/tool-reduction framing which requires context the cold audience doesn't have. Brand-aware and retargeting creatives lead with speed and familiarity — which works. Hypothesis: cold audience needs outcome-first framing (what they get, not what they stop paying for).
suggested_test_angles: Outcome framing: 'Close your Series A faster. Pepper runs your investor research.'
Social proof: 'Backed by 200 founders who replaced 3 SaaS tools in week 1.'
Problem-first: 'Still writing your weekly report manually? Your competitors aren’t.'
